notes.title: Patch 2.0 Audio Update and Performance Tweak
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch2.0 IS NOW AVAILABLE FOR DOWNLOAD![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32751583/8fa5a180f92397cb3ff7d3a4d1d25c13d5215fb9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Updates[/h1]
- After a number of requests by players, I have added enemy footsteps with sound attenuation and spacial occlusion. The addition of footsteps that fade based on distance, player position and camera rotation has changed the feel of the game enormously and made it much easier to locate and predict enemies.

- I've been working to push the performance of BRB even further than the improvements seen in the last patch. A number of models and textures have been further reduced to ensure maximum frame rates for players. 

[b]Thank you everyone again for supporting this solo project![/b]

notes.title: New Update available for download
notes.notes:
[h1]Performance and Lighting Update[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32751583/1c09dd0d0a36ddc41a84d813fe85bf5e3fe77ed8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Performance[/h1]
All textures and meshes are now fully optimised for max frame rates

- All textures have been compressed to minimise memory usage on trivial assets

- All meshes have been rebuilt or compressed to reduce triangle counts resulting in increased frames in "prop-heavy" parts of the map. 

[h1]Dynamic Lighting and Shadows[/h1]
The new tweaks to BRBs textures and meshes have opened up the opportunity to bring in dynamic lighting without killing players frame rates.

- A new method for casting and drawing shadows has been introduced

- Shadow artefacts on the landscape have been eliminated due to the new lighting system (no more random shadows on the ground)

- All buildings and props now cast shadows

- Lights on character suits now glow in the dark properly


[h1]Bug Fixes & News[/h1]

- Random shadows on the map eliminated (as mentioned above)

- Time before Health kits disappear has been reduced to eliminate blocking enemy spawns

- Enemy spawn points have been adjusted to minimise the possibility of enemies being pushed into the ground. [i](players may still experience some enemy spawn collision bugs but I am working towards a fix to eliminate this bug entirely.)[/i]

- The vehicle has been removed to improve driving performance and eliminate an issue with the weight of the vehicle causing wild flips. 

Thankyou again everyone for supporting Battle Royale Bootcamp, I hope you enjoy the improved frame rates!

[h1]Developer[/h1]
[b]Evan Murray[/b]

notes.title: Battle Royale Bootcamps major overhaul patch details.
notes.notes:
[h1]Official Trailer - Patch 1.2[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nXBmiW-LHhg

[h1]Patch 1.2 Details[/h1]

I want to personally thank everyone who has been supporting Battle Royale Bootcamp through Steam community links, social media and purchases through Steam. This being a solo project, the feedback and support from the community is extremely beneficial and helps me to make the right decisions with development. The small success in the first few months of Early Access gave me the opportunity to do a complete rebuild + overhaul for the game. I'm happy to announce that [b]Patch 1.2 is NOW LIVE![/b]

All current players can now open up Steam and download the complete overhaul as an update. New players will still be able to pick up the most advanced aim trainer on the market for the same small price of $5.99. 

[h1]Bug Note:[/h1] I have located and applied a fix for the keybinding clash between the default menu button and the interact button. Players can now open the menu with the "Escape" or "O" keys and use "E" for interact without issues. 

Thankyou everyone for making this new build possible!

[h1]Developer[/h1]
Evan Murray

notes.title: Patch 1.2 Update: Map + AI changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 1.2 Progress Report[/h1]

Patch 1.2 is starting to come together into a playable state but I've hit a few snags during the past few weeks. A number of the new building assets introduced massive performance issues and had to be sifted out and replaced. The process of rebuilding the main town has unfortunately delayed development but has ensured that the game engine is back to running smoothly. 

[h1]Check out the latest gameplay footage from the new building test here[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_G7qMfEWaXY

AI are now interacting with the new assets and making decisions on whether or not to attack/hide based on their current health. The introduction of a "defence mode" mechanic to the AI has made combat more dynamic. Real players will always be more unpredictable than AI but this is a big step in the right direction for Battle Royale Bootcamps AI bots. 

Thankyou all again for the support, I'm working hard to get this patch live ASAP
[b]Developer
Evan Murray[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE: Big plans for the coming months!
notes.notes:
Battle Royale Bootcamps first month in Early Access has been a huge success! 
As many of you know, this is a solo project so I would like to personally thank everyone who has invested the few bucks to get the game & provide me with much needed feedback. Both positive and negative feedback help me make decisions on how to implement improvements that the gaming community wants to see. 

You'll all be happy to hear that the small success in the first month of EA has provided me with an opportunity to do a complete overhaul for you guys. The concept of Battle Royale Bootcamp will remain the same but players can expect a cleaner, more polished gaming experience in a much larger training environment. 

Players who have been asking about multiplayer functionality, unfortunately will have to wait a little bit longer. I do have plans to introduce Co-op multiplayer so that players can practice squad tactics & call outs, but this will have to wait until after I have overhauled the single player version.

Developer
E.Murray
